# Treasury Management Analyzer Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Banking

## Overview

Use when analyzing corporate treasury management services including cash management, liquidity optimization, payment processing, and working capital management for commercial banking clients.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [treasury-management-analyzer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
treasury-management-analyzer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@treasury-management-analyzer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze treasury management fee revenue and product penetration rates
- Optimize cash pooling structures: notional, physical, cross-border
- Evaluate payment processing volumes and channel mix optimization
- Assess working capital metrics: DSO, DPO, DIO, cash conversion cycle

## Industry Standards Applied

- **AFP Best Practices**: Association for Financial Professionals treasury management standards
- **NACHA Rules**: ACH payment origination requirements for treasury management
- **ISO 20022**: Payment messaging standards for corporate treasury operations
